note: Public pages only. A campus is set only when the page names that person and a school in the campus list. A major without the word student is an affiliation, not enrollment. Playa House residents are current students or a recent graduate at UC Santa Barbara, which is not in the campus list, so they are kept without a campus. Not imported: AGI House photo names (no schools), HF0 staff (no schools), Frontier Tower first initials, FoundHer photo names that are not paired with a school, and the KTVU sentence that residents represented Cornell, Stanford, and Penn without saying who. Previous companies named in a bio (Mylon, nSynq, Bwenge-Lab) stay in the excerpt. The current company is the one stored.
